llm.summary: This is a legitimate requirements-analysis guide, but it needs review because it encourages AI analysis of customer logs and ongoing user-behavior monitoring without clear privacy safeguards.

dimensions.detail: If followed literally, the skill may cause an agent to process broad operational logs, feedback, code-impact data, and user-behavior telemetry; that access is purpose-aligned but under-scoped for a general skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains a Markdown SKILL.md only, with no executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact repeatedly frames AI extraction, automatic backflow, and continuous analysis as part of the workflow, but does not define consent, minimization, redaction, approval gates, retention, or limits on production telemetry use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system-level persistence or privilege escalation is present, but the methodology recommends Continuous Loop configuration with monitoring and trigger rules, so users should treat it as an ongoing data-processing workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requirements-engineering purpose is coherent, but the skill directs use of customer feedback, customer-service logs, app reviews, monitoring data, and user-behavior data, which can include sensitive personal or business data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable applying it to requirements work with your own privacy controls. Before using it on real customer feedback, support logs, production monitoring, or behavior analytics, require approval, remove personal data and secrets, minimize fields, document retention and access, and avoid sending sensitive telemetry to external AI services unless authorized.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted in context: analyzing customer feedback, service logs, app-store reviews, and similar data fits requirements engineering, but the artifact lacks privacy and data-handling controls for that potentially sensitive data.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted in context: continuous monitoring and user-behavior analysis fit the stated Continuous RE purpose, but the automatic, ongoing workflow is not bounded by governance, opt-in, minimization, anonymization, or approval safeguards.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the skill is mostly Chinese-language content, but it does not instruct the agent to override user language preference or create a security-relevant behavior.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The A.I.G scan reported no T01-T09 results, consistent with inspection showing no executable code, prompt hijacking, memory poisoning, remote execution, or tool spoofing.
